title: Declarative promptset changewatcher + staged re-eval controller
creator: Aisha Malik
description:
Goal: Implement a declarative change watcher and staged re-eval controller that ties configuration and model changes to targeted eval runs against permissioned golden prompt sets. The system should produce signed snapshot artifacts, delta summaries, and an automated gating decision that can block or allow config/model rollouts based on configurable regression thresholds.

Why: Today we run broad post-deploy evals which are slow, noisy, and often lack narrow ownership mapping. We need a targeted, auditable workflow that: 1) only re-evals promptsets that are impacted by a change, 2) preserves guardrails for golden dataset ownership/permissions, and 3) integrates with rollout policies (canary -> staged -> global).

High-level approach:
- Declarative watch rules: customers and internal teams declare which configs, model families, and routes map to which golden promptsets.
- Snapshot signing: every golden promptset state used for an eval must be captured as a signed snapshot (metadata: version, owner, acl, fingerprint, creation_ts, sample_seed).
- Delta detection: a lightweight differ computes which prompt examples are affected by a config/model change (prefix mismatches, tokenization differences, sampling seed shifts) and produces a delta score and candidate subset.
- Staged re-eval controller: kicks off small, fast re-evals (smoke/canary) on delta subset, then broader eval windows if smoke passes; failure at any stage triggers an abort and sends a rollback recommendation with concrete deltas.
- Audit + traceability: every evaluation run ties back to snapshot IDs, change reason, upstream PR/commit, and telemetry (latency/cost/quality).

Non-goals: full-scale automatic rollback (we provide decision support and optional auto-fallback policies as a separate feature), replacing existing bulk regression jobs immediately (we'll phase).

Acceptance criteria: (see acceptance_criteria field)
acceptance_criteria: Declarative watch rules can be created/updated via API and map config/model changes to one or more golden promptset snapshot IDs.
Signed snapshot format produced for any golden promptset export; signature verifiable by console and CI.
Delta detector identifies affected subset within 5s for promptsets <= 5k items and produces a deterministic fingerprint + delta-score.
Staged controller runs smoke evals automatically on delta subset and blocks rollout if regression > configured threshold; produces an actionable report with example failures.
Eval runs include metadata linking to change (commit/PR) and snapshot IDs; results are visible in Console and stored in eval-archive for replay.
RBAC enforced: only owners listed in snapshot ACL can approve forcing a rollout override; override actions are auditable.
End-to-end tests + one integration test that simulates a model config change and verifies staged gating behavior included in CI.
implementation_notes: API: add /watch-rules and /snapshot endpoints to evals service. Watch rule schema: {watch_id, triggers, promptset_ids, owners, severity, canary_policy}.
Snapshot format: JSON lines with header metadata; include SHA256 fingerprint and sign with platform key (HSM/KMS).
Delta detector: leverage existing vectorized tokenization microservice; fallback to naive diff for small sets. Prioritize speed and determinism over perfect recall.
Staged controller: implement as controller job in eval-orch with a configurable state machine (SMOKE -> BROAD -> FINAL). Use message queue for retries and backoff.
Metrics: gauge for delta_size, histogram for smoke_eval_latency, counter for blocked_rollouts. Create Console panels and alerts tied to these.
Data retention: eval results retained per project policy; signed snapshots immutable but mark deprecated snapshots via index updates.
Security: snapshot signing requires KMS key rotation docs; include security checklist for snapshot export and console display.
